s0.title: Open Health Connect
s0.desc: Tap the Health Connect row above to open or install it.

s1.title: App Permissions
s1.desc: Inside Health Connect, tap "App permissions" from the home screen.

s2.title: Find this app
s2.desc: Scroll to Rewards Planners and tap it.

s3.title: Enable Steps
s3.desc: Turn on "Steps" under the Read permissions toggle.

s4.title: Come back here
s4.desc: Return to this screen — the status refreshes automatically.

s5.title: Open phone Settings
s5.desc: Go to your phone's Settings app.

s7.title: Find Reward Planners
s7.desc: Search for and tap "Reward Planners" in the app list.

s8.title: Open Permissions
s8.desc: Tap "Permissions" on the app info screen.

s9.title: Allow the toggles
s9.desc: Turn on "Physical activity" and "Health Connect", then come back here.

s10.title: Connect Apple Health
s10.desc: Tap the Apple Health row above to show the iOS permission sheet.

s11.title: Allow Steps
s11.desc: In the Apple permission sheet, enable Steps and tap Allow.

s12.title: Come back here
s12.desc: Your step count refreshes automatically when you return.

s13.title: Open the Health app
s13.desc: Open Apple Health on your iPhone.

s14.title: Open Sharing
s14.desc: Tap Sharing, then Apps and Services.

s15.title: RewardsPlanners
s15.desc: Select RewardsPlanners and enable Steps access.

select.title: Which device do you use?
select.subtitle: We'll show you simple steps to connect your step data.
select.otherOnIos: You're using an iPhone. To track steps from an Android phone, install Reward Planners on that phone and sign in there.
select.otherOnAndroid: You're using an Android phone. To track steps from an iPhone, install Reward Planners on your iPhone and sign in there.

install.title: Install Health Connect
install.subtitle: Health Connect safely shares your step data with Reward Planners.
install.updateSubtitle: A newer version of Health Connect is needed to share your step data.
install.notFound: Install or update Health Connect from Google Play, then come back here.

open.title: Open Health Connect
open.subtitle: Open Health Connect to manage your step data.
open.tip: Search for "Health Connect" in your app list. On Android 14 and later, it's in Settings › Security & privacy › Privacy › Health Connect.
open.illustration: Phone app list with Health Connect highlighted

permission.title: Allow Step Permission
permission.subtitle: Allow Reward Planners to read your step count.
permission.tip: Reward Planners only reads your step count. You can turn this off anytime in Health Connect.
permission.denied: Turn on Steps for Reward Planners in Health Connect › App permissions, then come back here.
permission.noSource: Steps access is on, but no app is saving steps to Health Connect. Open Google Fit, Samsung Health or your fitness app, turn on Health Connect sync, then try again.
permission.illustration: Health Connect permission screen with Steps turned on for Reward Planners

apple.title: Use Apple Health
apple.subtitle: Your steps are already tracked in the Health app on your iPhone.
apple.info: The Health app comes pre-installed on your iPhone. You don't need to install anything.
apple.unavailable: Apple Health isn't available on this device, so steps can't be tracked here.

settings.title: Open iPhone Settings
settings.subtitle: Manage your health permissions in your iPhone's Settings or Health app.

find.title: Find Reward Planners
find.subtitle: Select Reward Planners in the relevant app or Health permissions list.
find.tip:
iOS 18 and later: Settings › Apps › Reward Planners › Health.
iOS 17 and earlier: Settings › Reward Planners › Health.
Or: Health app › your profile › Apps › Reward Planners.
find.illustration: iPhone Apps list with Reward Planners highlighted

allow.title: Allow Health Access
allow.subtitle: Allow Reward Planners to access your step data.
allow.mockBody: Reward Planners would like to access your health data.
allow.tip: Turn on "Steps", then come back here. For privacy, Apple doesn't tell apps whether read access is on — if your steps stay at 0 after walking, check this setting again.
allow.illustration: Health Access screen with Steps turned on

success.title: All Set!
success.body: Your step data is now connected. Return to the dashboard to see your progress.
success.coins: Hit your goals to earn coins
